submarine_cable_concentration.population_services_boundary: Disruptions affect economies, information access, public services and the daily lives of billions; no precise affected-person count is asserted.

uncertainty: Cable-system and fault totals are rounded global infrastructure statistics, and a cable fault is not necessarily a service outage at a landing point. Arctic ship counts cover the IMO Polar Code area; unique ships, aggregate distance and ship-type growth are retained as separate measures.
